items.text:
Google opens Gemini Tasks, enabling calls, bookings and purchases for hundreds of millions of users.

• The feature, first released to a limited tester group in May as Gemini Spark, later became Task Mode for Google AI Ultra subscribers.
• As of the announcement, the toggle is free for hundreds of millions of people using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.

items.text:
OpenAI faces $2 billion child safety lawsuit.

• Oregon Attorney General sued OpenAI, saying its chatbots endanger kids.
• The suit demands at least $2 billion in damages and claims age-verification can be bypassed.
• Parents and Teens in Oregon could see stricter controls or a court-ordered fix.

Meta posts AI deepfake of Sam Altman, sparking policy worries.

• Alexandr Wang shared a fake video of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on Instagram.
• The clip is labeled but reveals a loophole where static deepfakes remain unlabeled.
• This raises concerns for anyone worried about AI-generated likenesses on their feeds.
